author: Bobby Grayson
description: Where: elixir/fuzz.exs header, phase put0. The comparison was constrained, not the generator's comparison logic.
title: Registered-name divergence: after the cache dies the model drops sends to pid 0 (Config.deliver on a dead pid) but send(Cache, m) by name raises ArgumentError on the BEAM and would kill the reader on its next ask. Generator constraint: put 0 is always the last phase. Registration is static in the model (constant pid).
